title: animatic
description: The animatic's manifest (quality workflow, N27): the storyboard's beats timed to a scratch read, contiguous from 0 s to the read's end, with an optional music sketch. Paths are relative to this file and stay in the attempt's work folder.

spec_hash.description: `vpg spec hash spec/` when the animatic was made

voice.description: the scratch read (audio); its measured duration is the runtime

music.description: the music sketch (audio), aligned to the read from 0 s; its onsets are measured against MUSIC.md hit points

video.description: the timed boards rendered as a video, for the human review; its measured duration also counts
